Megakaryoblastic leukemia is a marrow and blood-cell malignancy; Down syndrome does not establish additional organ involvement by the leukemia.
Congenital myopathy with spinal rigidity; cardiac conduction abnormalities 30-79%. Respiratory insufficiency reflects muscle weakness without established intrinsic lung damage.
Intellectual disability and developmental delay in 8/8; seizures in 5/8. Ocular and skeletal abnormalities are below 30%.
Lysosomal storage disorder with progressive corticospinal degeneration. Bladder dysfunction is neurogenic; intrinsic urinary tract damage is not established.
Calcium deposition and inflammation in tendons; no evidence of a systemic metabolic or autoimmune disorder.
Acquired abnormality of erythrocyte hemoglobin; other organ damage is not inherent to this umbrella concept.
Gonadal dysgenesis with endocrine failure supported by elevated LH and FSH in 3/3; genital anatomy alone adds no axis.
Amyloid damages cerebral vessel walls; hemorrhage, focal brain injury and progressive neurological deterioration define the disease.
Cardiomyopathy/arrhythmia, encephalopathy/developmental impairment and rhabdomyolysis each 80-99%; common hepatic injury omitted at the four-axis cap.
Autoimmune/autoinflammatory childhood arthritis. Uveitis and systemic organ complications do not affect at least 30% across the umbrella.
Non-neoplastic polyp arising in vocal-fold mucosa; the larynx belongs to the pulmonary axis.
Congenital cleft of the laryngeal/postcricoid partition between airway and esophagus; swallowing dysfunction is characteristic.
Malignancy involving the oral cavity; mouth and salivary glands belong to the gastrointestinal axis.
Breast carcinoma has no organ axis in this scheme; receptor expression does not establish endocrine-gland disease.
Inherited hemoglobin abnormality causing neonatal anemia and cyanosis; cyanosis does not establish cardiac or pulmonary damage.
Defines craniofacial dysplasia, alopecia and hypogonadism. Intellectual disability/encephalocele 80-99%; ocular and dental defects also frequent, omitted at cap.
Callosal hypoplasia and retinal abnormalities each reported in 1/1; evidence is sparse. Respiratory distress alone does not establish direct lung damage.
Sarcoma originates in the uterine cervix, a reproductive organ outside the axes; sarcoma histology does not establish locomotor involvement.
Skin atrophy defines disease. Joint hypermobility 80-99% and scoliosis 30-79%; supplied HPO also reports intellectual disability at 30-79%.
Dopamine transporter dysfunction causes a central movement disorder with parkinsonism and dystonia; no additional organ damage is established.
Benign fibrovascular growth arising from skin; metabolic associations do not establish metabolic disease in this concept.
Inherited susceptibility to CLL, rather than established leukemia; a later cancer risk does not establish current blood or immune disease.
Transient riboflavin-related metabolic dysfunction with acidosis and hypoglycemia; complete resolution and no established additional organ damage.
Developmental disability and obesity are defining features, each 80-99%; coagulation abnormalities occur in 30-79%. Cardiac and hepatic lesions are occasional.
